name: Rent_Prediction
what_it_holds: Data retrieval of Swiss rental properties from Immoscout24, with cleaning/analysis and both a regression model and a from-scratch neural network for rent estimation.
why_useful: Second Swiss Immoscout24 rental pull method; corroborates hamedrazavi repo above for a Switzerland LTR proxy.

name: Zillow-dataset-samples
what_it_holds: Sample of 1,000+ Zillow listings extracted via the Bright Data scraping API, committed as a demo dataset (for-sale/for-rent listing attributes, images, prices).
why_useful: Small demo only (1k rows, marketing sample for a paid scraping service), but confirms Bright Data's Zillow scraper output schema if the team ever wants to replicate a pull.

name: immo
what_it_holds: Bot monitoring immoscout24.de and wg-gesucht.de for new German flat listings and auto-applying.
why_useful: Live-monitoring method covering two German rental portals at once (Immoscout24 + WG-Gesucht); marginal beyond ImmoSpider/immoscraper above, but wg-gesucht adds shared-flat/room-rental coverage not seen elsewhere.

name: zoopla (Python wrapper)
what_it_holds: Thin Python wrapper around the (now largely defunct/restricted) Zoopla API, described as giving access to '27m homes, over 1m sale and rental listings, and 15 years of sold price data' when the API was open. No data committed; 89 stars, only 5 commits.
why_useful: Low value now since Zoopla closed most of its public API; kept for completeness as a UK rental-data acquisition method if API access is restored.
last_activity: unclear, low commit count suggests stale

name: Saudi-Real-Estate-Data
what_it_holds: 4.93M real-estate transactions from Saudi Ministry of Justice (MOJ) and REGA, 2018-2025, covering sales, mortgages, seizures AND rentals across 13 regions of Saudi Arabia. Jupyter Notebook repo, 10 stars, last updated ~22 May 2026.
why_useful: A large, multi-year, government-sourced committed rental+sales transaction dataset outside the US/EU (APAC/MENA gap adjacent); could proxy Gulf-region housing/rental cost trends relevant to a fast-growing ABNB market (Saudi/Gulf tourism), though not a direct STR proxy.
